newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Alcatel CIT says it will shed 1,600 jobs.
newsitem.headline: France's Alcatel CIT says it will shed 1,600 jobs.

text.p: France's Alcatel CIT, a branch of Alcatel Alsthom, said it will shed 1,600 of its 9,400 jobs by the end of next year in a reorganisation to cut costs ahead of telecommunications deregulation.
It forecast operational losses of 500 million francs this year.
Alcatel CIT, which provides equipment for France-Telecom, said it faced dwindling orders from the state telecommunications operator.
It said annual orders for the 1995-96 period had fallen by 40 percent from the 1992-94 period, and the trend looked likely to continue in 1997-98 despite recent orders from Asian countries.
The company said job cuts would mainly affect its factories in Lannion and Ormes but no factory would be closed down.
